query: select sum(amount_cents) from acme.fct_orders where status in ($1, $2) and created_at >= $3
select count(*) from acme.fct_orders where status = $1

select o.ship_region, sum(o.amount_cents) from acme.fct_orders o join acme.dim_customers c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id where o.status in ($1, $2) and c.is_test_account = $3 group by o.ship_region
select p.category, sum(i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents) from acme.fct_order_items i join acme.dim_products p on p.product_id = i.product_id group by p.category
